business_problem: Genus PLC (LON:GNS) is a world-leading animal genetics company.
solution_summary: Genus modernized core business workflows around Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 Finance, and Dynamics 365 Human Resources because Genus PLC (LON:GNS) is a world-leading animal genetics company. Instead of relying on fragmented local systems, the organization now runs shared finance, customer, service, retail, or supply-chain processes through a cloud platform that acts as a common system of record. Operational transactions move through Dynamics-based workflows, while supporting analytics and low-code extensions keep reporting, exception handling, and local process needs inside the same Microsoft estate rather than recreating new point solutions. That architecture gives business teams a consistent data backbone for daily execution and leadership insight, reducing manual reconciliation and creating room to scale. In practice, The company employs more than 3,500 people around the world.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
solution_components.role: Coordinates cases, service interactions, and end-user requests on a unified CRM platform.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Field Service
solution_components.role: Schedules and tracks service execution in the modernized business workflow.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Finance
solution_components.role: Centralizes finance transactions, controls, and reporting in the cloud ERP backbone.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Human Resources
solution_components.role: Standardizes workforce and HR processes within the broader business platform.

data_flow: Operational data enters shared Dynamics workflows, is processed through the relevant business modules and supporting automations, and is then surfaced to employees through ERP screens, service views, or Power BI reporting.
business_outcome: The company employs more than 3,500 people around the world.
metrics: Genus serves more than 50,000 customers in more than 75 countries, primarily through Genus ABS (focusing on dairy and beef cattle) and Genus PIC (focusing on pigs).

Genus was growing rapidly, as farmers sought to meet the rising demand for animal protein, and as result, was working with 15 disparate enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and multiple discrete software solutions on five continents.
The company began by introducing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources in 2019, followed by a multi-phase implementation of Dynamics 365 Human Resources, Finance, and Supply Chain Management.
Sales and Customer Service was implemented for key operational locations in 2020, with the roll-out to other regions beginning in 2021.
Locations have been prioritized according to business needs, with 15 country locations now live.
